TBH Clone with better mechanics I think for item and resource management, but more complex. For those who worried about p2w, this game is using pay to progress mechanics for PvE only.

These are the buffs I get so far after reaching level 25 which you should pay if you want to, it's optional:
1. Blessing of the First Journey (1 USD - PERMANENT): 30% Gold + XP + Drop Rate, 1 Storage Page, +20 Inventory Slot
2. Expedition Contract (1 USD - ONLY 30 DAYS AFTER PURCHASE): Training Token 30K, Raid Skip Feature Unlocked: Raid Participation Rewards x2, Stun Resistance 30%, PvE Attack Power 10%, PvE Defense 10%
3. Subjugator's Contract (1 USD - ONLY 30 DAYS AFTER PURCHASE): Unlock Stone (for random ability unlock passive, you can unlock so many times until you're satisfied) 30K, World Boss Skip feature unlocked: World Boss Participation Rewards x2, Boss DMG 20%, PvE Dmg Taken Decrease 20%.

Total 3 USD so far, at least at my level. (EDIT: I add some explanation for number 2-3, I missed that)

Inventory slot can be upgraded manually using gold, no need to pay. As the XP and gold boost is not.

I hope the developers can review this issue properly and fix the system instead of blindly banning players.

Very disappointing. Not recommended.

EARLY ACCESS REVIEW
The game has some really good mechanics.

Auto-Combine is great for inventory management. Low-tier items can quickly fill your inventory in an idle game, so being able to combine them automatically saves a lot of unnecessary micromanagement.

Failed upgrades are also handled really well. When an upgrade fails, you get Fragments that can be used in the Relic system, so you still make progress instead of completely wasting your resources.

The combat animations looks good. The attacks, effects and character animations make the battles satisfying to watch, especially for an idle game.

The Raid and Boss Challenges also give you extra pve content to test your progress and see how strong your builds are.

**Context →** The game says that it allows refunds.

I bought the premium pass, had buyer's remorse, and asked for a refund. Steam approved the refund, but the money was pending.

A few hours later, I managed to sell an item and thought, *"Well, maybe I could use this money and buy the premium pack for good this time, since I didn't spend my own money."*

One day later, the pending money was added to my account. I instantly got disconnected and couldn't log back in. I don't know if my account got banned or not.

Again, they did state that you could get a refund if it was within 7 days, and I requested the refund less than an hour after the purchase. [ And remember i was thinking on buying the pass for good this time]

Well, I guess it's time to play other games...
